about: Third development set: fresh1 and fresh2, folded in after use. Honest first-run scores when each was still held out: fresh1 flips 8.1%, feeling 65.7%, topic 90.9%; fresh2 flips 3.0%, feels-right 72.0%, feeling 57.0%, topic 92.0%. They were then used to tune the engine, so they are now development sets. Add a new fresh set to measure honestly again.
